name: 2.0.0-test-rc23 focused checklist
description: Focused checks for complete private catalogs under on-prem overrides and stable Optimize graph layout.

items.name: Combined image replaces legacy fallback catalogs
items.description: Test: Upgrade an existing on-prem RC22 instance to the authorized combined RC23 image without deleting its workspace or runtime configuration, then open Suggested in Evals and Guardrails. Pass: Evals shows 15 and Guardrails shows 15, their URLs use the private plugin identities instead of plugin-lab fallback identities, every Eval includes at least three cases, and prior Active items remain available.

items.name: Private plugin inventory resets stale navigation order
items.description: Test: After the RC23 upgrade, refresh the same browser and inspect Plugins before manually rearranging anything. Pass: The initial private inventory is Evals, Guardrails, Optimize, Review; a prior order saved for the public fallback inventory does not carry over; and a new manual rearrangement still persists after refresh.

items.name: Optimize relationship legend does not flicker
items.description: Test: Open Optimize > Suggested > Relationship and move the pointer repeatedly across several plan nodes at desktop and narrow widths. Pass: The description may change for the highlighted plan, but Optimizes, Plan, and Target remain together on the same stable second row without shifting right, wrapping again, or moving the graph.
